_comment: Baseline for the owner-GATED surfaces an agent must not change without per-action approval in chat. Verified by the `ritual-compliance` probe (RB-008). This file is the RECORD of what was approved as of asOf; a diff between it and the tree means a gated action was taken (or that the owner approved something and this file was not updated — either way it must surface at orient, not pass silently). Same principle as config/repo-scope.json: write the fact down as a field rather than leaving a tool to infer it (cycle 129).

hooks._rule: Installing hooks is GATED. Hooks can be declared WITHOUT a .claude/hooks directory — a `hooks` key in any .claude/settings*.json is enough, which is why the check looks at both.

skills._rule: Installing skills is GATED. These three predate the gate and are the approved baseline; a NEW directory here means a skill was installed.

backups._rule: Deleting either backup is GATED and irreversible (~29-30 GB each, owner decision pending). The check asserts they still EXIST — it is a tripwire against the deletion, not a size assertion.

politeness._rule: Loosening politeness is GATED. There is no single floor CONSTANT to assert (the effective floor is max() of robots + stored values, and adaptive speed-up is pre-existing behaviour), so the check guards the part that matters most and IS static: the 429 backoff escalation must not be weakened or deleted.
